column1: # Sample Requirements Traceability Matrix — Retail Order Fulfilment Programme
# TestCaseIDs are separated by ';'. Deliberately includes a few problems so
# validate_rtm.py has something to find — see tools/README.md.

column2: The system shall accept an order only when all lines have available stock.
The system shall reserve stock for 30 minutes when a customer reaches checkout.
Backorders shall be flagged on the order confirmation email.
Dispatch notes shall print automatically when a picker completes a wave.
Partial shipments shall be allowed for orders over 10 line items.
The warehouse dashboard shall refresh at least every 5 minutes.
Refunds for failed deliveries shall be raised within 24 hours.
Orders flagged as fraud-risk shall be routed to a manual review queue.
Customers shall be able to cancel an order before it is dispatched.
The fulfilment SLA report shall be generated every Monday at 07:00.
Carrier tracking numbers shall be pushed to the customer account page.
Damaged-goods claims shall be logged against the original dispatch record.
Order data shall be retained for 7 years after fulfilment.
